title: Python style conformance
summary: The code style batch pass MUST apply the Python style guidance this policy references to durable repository Python.
instructions: Agents repairing Python style MUST read the complete Python style guidance this policy references, and MUST apply it before completion.
Agents MUST NOT reconstruct or separately load the formatter-owned appendix of the Python style guidance unless they are changing formatter configuration or integration.
Agents MUST repair only the judgment-level Python rules the style guidance states; the configured Python formatter stays authoritative for mechanical style.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you repair Python style.
